label: Can be in more ways: CanBeInMoreWays x: x can be in more than one way
term: can be in more ways (pluribus modis se habere posse; πλεοναχῶς ἔχειν)
definition: `CanBeInMoreWays x`: x can be in more than one way. In Metaph. V, lect. 6 n. 14 says it of composites, because they are mutable. A Lean parameter of WhatCanBeInMoreWaysCanBeOtherwiseReading, relative to no respect, and not defined from CanFailToBe or CanBeOtherwise.
